review_notes: Corrected the treatment of ἐθνῶν: the accepted alignment gave it the anaphoric them and marked the Gentiles added under rule 103, which reverses the two mentions. Rule 103's added units are English whose licensing token has already spent its English on an earlier word, and it names a resumptive pronoun as the contrast that folds onto its token; here the full lexical mention comes first and the pronoun is the anaphor, so both are one discontinuous realization of ἐθνῶν under rule 15, headed on Gentiles.
The ASV italicizes neither the nor Gentiles, which under rule 11 is evidence against reading them as supplied.
The verse now carries no added unit and every source and target id is partitioned exactly once.
